speaker: Doctor

The blood smear is normal, which makes parasitic infections like malaria or chagas disease unlikely. Since you have diabetes, I need to rule out a bacterial skin infection; do you see any pus-filled centers or honey-colored crusting on the bumps?

speaker: Doctor
text: The negative skin culture rules out a bacterial infection like impetigo or cellulitis. Since the itching is intense and localized to the thigh after travel to Miami, I suspect this may be an insect bite reaction, such as from bed bugs or chiggers. DIAGNOSIS READY: Insect bite hypersensitivity (papular urticaria)
